fixtures.given: A caller requests GitHub pull-request operations without loading every installed Facility schema.
proof: only matching operation schemas are returned
schema version and Provider identity are retained
Ptah does not choose the operation

fixtures.given: A Grant permits observe operations but a caller submits a destructive operation.
proof: no Attempt with external effect begins
denial Receipt names the effect class and configured boundary

fixtures.given: A connected account can read only a subset of external records.
proof: Ptah does not expand external access
Provider account and scope provenance remain visible

fixtures.given: A human approves one app action whose external account lacks the requested scope.
proof: approval does not create Provider permission
failed effect is retained separately from the approval record

fixtures.given: A connector returns a file reference but no bytes have been mounted or copied into the execution Environment.
proof: availability state remains external_reference
a separate materialization Activity is required

fixtures.given: A caller explicitly materializes an external file for a sandboxed Activity.
proof: source Provider and external identity remain linked
digest and materialization Receipt are retained

fixtures.given: A long-running Activity produces two Artifacts and then fails.
proof: failed Attempt remains visible
partial Artifacts retain lineage
no success claim is generated

fixtures.given: A Facility returns a result larger than the active Session budget.
proof: result can be paged or searched
bounded reads cite the same retained result identity

fixtures.given: A write Activity targets Revision A but the Object moved to Revision B before execution.
proof: Revision B is not overwritten
conflict Receipt retains both expected and observed revision identities

fixtures.given: A caller asks an application to prepare a customer message without sending it.
proof: draft and publish are separate Activities
no external-side-effect Receipt exists

fixtures.given: A tool call was submitted but the Provider returned no completion response.
proof: no succeeded Receipt is fabricated
verification may be requested as a separate Activity

fixtures.given: Three Attempts respectively receive human denial, Provider failure and caller cancellation.
proof: declined, failed and cancelled remain distinguishable
none is rewritten as successful

fixtures.given: One Receipt is displayed as a chat card, table and mobile summary.
proof: all Views cite the same record identity
removing one View does not remove the Receipt

fixtures.given: A UI card labels a candidate green while the underlying acceptance record remains pending.
proof: View styling creates no acceptance record
caller must issue the authority decision

fixtures.given: A condition-triggered Activity checks its source and the configured condition is false.
proof: check Attempt is retained
no notification Artifact is emitted

fixtures.given: A scheduled Activity requests a Workspace file that was not supplied in its immutable input set.
proof: schedule does not inherit hidden Session context
missing input is reported

fixtures.given: A Session created on mobile is resumed through a desktop application using the same Workspace records.
proof: stable identities survive UI replacement
Provider and device changes create no authority change

fixtures.given: Two independent workers return conflicting conclusions.
proof: Ptah may execute a caller-supplied merge Recipe
Ptah does not decide which conclusion is correct

fixtures.given: An Activity exceeds its configured execution or product limit.
proof: limit class and measured value are reported
Ptah does not silently reduce semantic scope

fixtures.given: A configured retry begins after a failed Attempt.
proof: failed Attempt remains retained
retry has a new identity and links to its predecessor
